The '''Salissian mercenaries''' were an organization active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Three members of the [[Salissian/Legends|Salissian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] were killed by the [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]] [[Phow Ji]].
